newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT - Alaska gets mixed reviews.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Alaska gets mixed reviews.

text.p: Alaska Milk Corp received mixed reviews from three different securities firms on Tuesday after it announced a 45 percent drop in its net income last year.
The company said it posted a net income of 116 million pesos last year, down from 212 million pesos the previous year due to lower margins.
Angping Securities recommended a buy on Alaska saying the company was on its way to recovery following an improvement in its financial performance in the fourth quarter.

Angping analyst Carla Garcia said lower skimmed milk prices, which comprise 50 percent of its production cost, the introduction of two new products and the rise in consumer spending would boost its 1997 net income by about 87 percent.
"Based on the favourable figures and rosy prospects for AMC, we recommend a buy on the issue," she said.
Anscor Hagedorn Securities analyst Ana Patricia Hocson said although the future seemed rosy, its present price was already fair value. She recommended Alaska as a long-term buy.
On the other hand, Citisecurities said it had downgraded its recommendation to a hold from a buy.
"Although plans for the company seem promising, competition still looks intense," Citisecurities said.
